name: Councillor Bridget

intro.text: My great-great-grandmother was a Bridget too. She scrubbed floors on Beacon Hill. I sit on the city council. That's the story of this town in two lines. Shall we?

win: Not bad. You'd get my vote.
after: Boston's Irish rose from labourers and servants to city hall within a few generations. Mayors such as John F. Fitzgerald, JFK's grandfather, came out of the Irish wards.
